services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text: Jimmy Ross garage is a GO TO . Its imperative that you take your car here for any mechanic work, they are efficient , thorough & most of all, the customer service is exceptional. Big thanks to Jimmy and Mike for taking extra good care of my car and getting all the work done faster than expected. True professionals here.

reviews.author: Daniel Herman Jr
reviews.text: Jimmie was so helpful for us when our Prius had its ABS light turn on. He helped us fix it and then it broke down again and then he fixed it again and when he wasn’t able to fix it anymore, he didn’t charge us for the extra time he spent trying to figure it all out. We had a great experience and highly recommend his garage! We will be back again.

reviews.author: Jamie Powell
reviews.text: If you want a good honest mechanic that fixes your vehicle right the first time and isn’t going to take advantage of you Jimmy Ross garage is the place you want to. I have used him twice now and both times was an awesome experience! I was fully prepared to pay for 4 solenoids to get fixed and while they were working on the truck they realized only 2 needed fix d and 2 needed cleaning, they kept it honest and kept the price honest. Ontop of that they know what they are doing and they do it great! The customer service is also spectacular always so nice and helpful! This garage has my full respect and I will never take any of my vehicles anywhere else! They always give you a paper of the full breakdown of what was done and the price for everything including labor. Happy to have my truck back!!!!

reviews.author: Teej Trojan
reviews.text: I exclusively use Jimmie Ross. Ge is fair, honest, trustworthy and does good work. When one repair didn't work out. He had me bring back and fixed again without charge.

reviews.author: Trixie Monte
reviews.text: The driver side power window was not working in the old pick up I received as a gift. Jimmie, within a few hours, took great care to rewire the power and replaced some of the broken/missing parts of the door's interior. We are new to the area and are grateful to know that whenever we need a repair, we can rely on Jimmie for an honest estimate, timely repair and a fair price.

reviews.author: Mike Meagher
reviews.text: Great work on both of our vehicles! We have a 23 year old vehicle we’re nursing along and are excited we found Ross Garage. Jimmie is fair, a straight shooter and is an expert with auto repair knowledge. If you want to get away from the dealerships, this is the place! We’ll be customers from here on out.

reviews.author: Shelley Dayton
reviews.text: The ideal small town mechanic! Jimmie and his team are capable of repairing a wide variety of vehicles. We have a ‘92 Miata, a ‘95 Subaru Sambar, a 2014 F150 pickup and a 2020 Honda Fit - Jimmie seems to be knowledgable about all of them and keeps them running with prompt attention at a very reasonable price. Cannot say enough good things about him! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Elias Latto
reviews.text: Jimmie and Dave are extremely helpful and honest about any car issue I have had since using their services for 3 years. Unlike other car shops I've dealt with, they are reliable, fast, and tell me when to keep track of an issue that doesn't require immediate repair. I live in Spartanburg and drive 40 minutes because the quality of their service and even have cars towed there due to poor experiences from dealerships/other shops in town.

reviews.author: Tammi Bruning
reviews.text: Had ball joints replaced during their warranty period. Jimmie's garage went to bat for me with parts supplier and was able to get labor paid for as well. They communicated regularly on timeframe of completion. Very professional service.

reviews.author: Lisa Skates
reviews.text: Typical girl, I called and told Mr Ross I needed him to check my car, what I said was, my car shakes bad its nervous are has a tic IDK. I took it in went to work thinking this is gonna be bad and prepared to be floored with the damage and price. Got a call from Mr Ross that it just needs a tune up, new spark plugs, coil pack etc. Apparently, I ran it almost dead before I called for help. He informed me he had time to fix it that day while I was at work! He did just that fixed and had it waiting on me after work. My car runs better than ever and the price did floor me, it was NO where near what I thought it would be!!!! WAY LESS!!!! If you have issues go see him, he knows exactly what he is doing, want over charge you are tell you something's wrong when it's not!!!! Very professional and trustworthy!!! Also they want make fun of you for not knowing how to explain the issue, like it's just nervous lol

reviews.author: Robi Smith
reviews.text: My husband and I have used Jimmy for the last 25 years and have never had any complaints. Jimmy and his staff go well out of their way to care for their clients. If you need mechanic that is honest and knowledgeable, which seems to be a rarity these days, give them a shot - you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: J Ann
reviews.text: We have been looking for an honest and fair mechanic since we moved here 2 years ago. We will be looking no more, Jimmy is our new mechanic and we couldn't be more pleased. I ran a repair shop for years so I take it very seriously when it comes to who can touch my cars. I'm 100% sure I trust his opinion and knowledge! Great heart and passion for his job and community.

reviews.author: Meg Boone
reviews.text: Outstanding customer service; above and beyond. Getting your car repaired is stressful enough, having efficiency, competent service AND kindness are a rare combination in this business and they have all three. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Barbara Wilder
reviews.text: Took my car here for the first time today, but now I won't be taking it anywere else. JRG is highly recommended in this area, and now I see why. Great service, nice people, fair prices. Add me to the list of happy customers!

reviews.author: John David Fleming Sr
reviews.text: Just purchased a used vehicle. Steering g seemed a bit off even tho the truck tracked straight. A good alignment was all I needed, $39.95. Driving excellent now. Got a few recommendations on another small issue. Honest straightforward folks here.

reviews.author: Kim Wooten Godfrey
reviews.text: Jimmie had fixed my son's trucks several times and we will keep using him. Very honest hard worker. Very reasonable

reviews.author: Misty Gamboa
reviews.text: I brought my car to him to have the damage repaired, He didn't really do the whole damage and then he would charge me in full amount. without any consideration. And he should first ask. if he could not properly repair the damage to my car before he should do so. seems unprofessional. and rude.

reviews.author: Susi Gott Séguret
reviews.text: I stopped in without introduction when my muffler fell off on the interstate nearby. Was immediately welcomed and fixed so that I could drive on, in the midst of a busy day. Forever grateful for the kindness and generosity.

reviews.author: Jennifer Parham
reviews.text: Love this place, great customer service, car is back to running good and they gave me details on what else was wrong. Also fixed something that was wrong with my brake I highly recommend this place. Will be recommending to family & friends!

reviews.author: P J Zullo
reviews.text: Our son was traveling from NC to FL for school when he had car trouble in SC. They helped immediately. They were friendly and got the repair done quickly. We are so grateful and thankful.

reviews.author: Linda Holley
reviews.text: I don't know what I would do without Jimmie's auto repair. Not only great work but a kind owner and employees who go out of their way to be of service!

reviews.author: Joseph Myerscough
reviews.text: I was having problems with my vehicle and was able to be seen quickly and my problem was Diagnosed quickly. The work was done right the first time. I will make them my mechanic from now on

reviews.author: Ken Fortenberry
reviews.text: was on my way home to N.C.had a idler pulley seize up throwing serpentine belt off,found rhem on google maps and seen I was about 6 miles out,made it in there without power steering,power brakes,no engine fan, no alternator,they found parts and had them there and on my way in little over an hour,Jimmy,Dave and the lady that answered phone were all great

reviews.author: Lee Heelan
reviews.text: Best mechanic in the area. I wouldn't take my vehicles anywhere else. Trustworthy and very nice too.

reviews.author: Anita Peeler
reviews.text: Prices are expensive, however, At least when I get my car back from these guys I know it will be fixed. And to me, that is worth paying for. Thanks

reviews.author: Chuck Roush
reviews.text: Jimmy Ross does a great job of keeping our 2016 Subaru and 2001 Toyota on the road. His prices are reasonable and he goes the extra mile.
